purpose: Convert verified shopping/affiliate evidence into useful article, card, video, Shorts/Reels and Pin drafts without hidden advertising, spam or unverified offer claims.

articleTemplate.maxCommercialDensity: do not repeat the same product/link mechanically; one useful slot per natural section unless the comparison itself is the article purpose

videoTemplate.rule: PPL is a scene asset, not a forced commercial break. Remove it when it harms story, usefulness, retention or policy compliance.

YOUTUBE.shopping: Use YouTube Shopping/product tagging when the channel/item is eligible; otherwise use allowed description/link routes.
YOUTUBE.ppl: Paid product placements, sponsorships or endorsements must be declared with YouTube paid-promotion controls when applicable. Do not embed advertiser-supplied pre/mid/post-roll style video ads where YouTube offers comparable ad formats.
YOUTUBE.draftGate: prepare metadata, product tags/links, disclosure and PPL scene plan; public publish remains gated

INSTAGRAM.shopping: Use supported product/affiliate link surfaces only when available to the account and region.
INSTAGRAM.ppl: Branded-content/commercial relationships require the platform's paid partnership/branded-content disclosure where applicable.
INSTAGRAM.draftGate: Reels/post/story package includes disclosure state before publish

TIKTOK.shopping: Use supported shopping/creator commerce surfaces only when account/region eligible.
TIKTOK.ppl: Content promoting a brand, product or service must carry the commercial-content disclosure setting; branded content is labeled as paid partnership where applicable.
TIKTOK.draftGate: commercial-content disclosure state is mandatory before branded-content publish

PINTEREST.shopping: Affiliate links may be used when transparent, original and useful; avoid spam and artificial distribution.
PINTEREST.ppl: Paid partnership/commercial content requires clear disclosure or available paid-partnership label.
PINTEREST.draftGate: Pin must add unique value and relevant board context; no link-spam templates

NAVER_BLOG.shopping: Keep promotional links proportional to informational value. Avoid repeated mechanically generated promotional posts or repeated external-link promotion.
NAVER_BLOG.ppl: Use clear Korean disclosure for advertising/sponsorship/affiliate relationships when applicable.
NAVER_BLOG.automation: No unattended public posting/login/search scraping through browser automation without an explicitly permitted route; Publisher Core stays draft/approval-first.

NAVER_CAFE.shopping: Follow community and cafe rules; no repetitive promotion or referral spam.
NAVER_CAFE.ppl: Commercial nature must be clear when applicable.
NAVER_CAFE.automation: draft/approval only unless an official or explicitly permitted publish route exists

NAVER_CLIP.shopping: Treat as short-video commerce only when platform/account supports it.
NAVER_CLIP.ppl: clear commercial disclosure; reuse SHORTS PPL template but platform-specific QA required
NAVER_CLIP.automation: draft/approval only until verified provider route

BLOGGER.shopping: Article shopping links are optional and must be useful, current and disclosed when affiliate/commercial.
BLOGGER.ppl: video embeds and article mentions inherit the originating platform disclosure requirements
BLOGGER.draftGate: Blogger draft may be prepared automatically under existing route; public publish follows Publisher Core gate

contentOsIntegration.fallback: If price, delivery, eligibility, disclosure or product identity is uncertain, publish an organic draft without shopping/PPL and keep the commerce lane PENDING.
